newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil, soymeal seen lower with soybeans.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil, soymeal seen lower with soybeans.

text.p: CBOT soyoil and soymeal futures were expected to follow soybeans to a lower open early Monday, floor traders said.
Soymeal futures were seen $1.00 to $2.00 per ton lower, and soyoil was seen 0.15 to 0.20 cent per lb lower on the open, traders said.
CBOT soybeans were expected to open five to seven cents per bushel lower following drenching Midwest rains this weekend.
Supportive factors in Monday's soyoil trade included reports that U.S. exporters sold 20,000 tonnes of soyoil for shipment to unknown destinations and talk of lower soyoil content.
Cooler weather in the Midwest this week could lower soyoil content in the new crop, floor traders said.
In soymeal, news that South Korea was tendering for 40,000 tonnes of soymeal for September/October shipment was seen as supportive, traders said.
